title: Utility Line Protection Plans Training Note: Public-Way Restoration Already Paid on a Linked Request

# Training Note: Public-Way Restoration Already Paid on a Linked Request

Care center training note in question-and-answer form, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## The rule

Public-way recall offset: for a recall reported no later than the plan's repair guarantee days after the most recent completed repair on the same line, the public-way restoration payment is the public-way restoration figure less the public-way restoration payments already authorized on the request of that completed repair, never below zero; for a new failure reported no more than the public-way continuation days after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line, the public-way restoration payment is the public-way restoration figure less the public-way restoration payments already authorized on that temporary-repair request, never below zero; every other public-way restoration payment is the public-way restoration figure in full. The offset acts on the public-way restoration figure, and the occurrence benefit still open limits the result after it.

## Questions answered

**What are the repair guarantee days and the continuation days?**
The repair guarantee is 180 calendar days on every Utility Line Protection Plan. The public-way continuation days are 14 calendar days.

**A recall arrives 180 days after the completed repair on the same line. Is the offset taken?**
Yes. A recall reported on day 180 or earlier takes the offset; on day 181 the figure is paid in full.

**A new failure arrives 14 days after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line. Is the offset taken?**
Yes, against the public-way restoration payments on that temporary-repair request. On day 15 the figure is paid in full.

**Which payments are subtracted?**
Only public-way restoration payments already authorized on the linked request.

**Can the result go below zero?**
No. Where the payments already authorized exceed the figure, the amount is zero.

## Hypothetical example

Figure $2500.00; $1500.00 of public-way restoration already authorized on the completed repair's request; recall on day 30: $1000.00 before the open-benefit limit.
